description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling RetrieveConnection commands in a connectivity messaging context. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides a method to process the command, returning either a successful result with connection details or an error if the connection entity is not accessible.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStrategy
classes.description: A final class that provides a specific strategy for retrieving connection data in response to a RetrieveConnection command within a connectivity messaging system.

methods.name: RetrieveConnectionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that registers the command type this strategy handles.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Processes the RetrieveConnection command, returning a Result containing either the connection details or an error if inaccessible.
